## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | TQ 300 mg, PQ 0.5 mg/kg over 7 days, PQ 0.25mg/kg over 14 days | Counselling for adverse events - acute hemolytic anemia for patients receiving tafenoquine & 7-day PQ, self-monitoring using a malaria patient card for all patients, including G6PD test results |
| **G6PD Intermediate** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg over 14 days, PQ 0.75 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks | Counseling for adverse events, self-monitoring using a malaria patient card for all patients, including G6PD test results |
| **G6PD Deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks | Counseling for adverse events, self-monitoring using a malaria patient card for all patients, including G6PD test results |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg over 14 days | Counseling for adverse events, self-monitoring using a malaria patient card for all patients, including G6PD test results |
